m65acfd20cb72: Edit in a separate browser page; saves write directly to the remote host. Stopping the editor, closing its SSH connection, or locking the master password closes the editor connection.
m3c747325cf69: Installs in the current SSH user's directory without administrator privileges. Each version is downloaded once and uploaded from the local cache afterward.
metadata.name: Remote VS Code
metadata.description: Opens a separate remote editor for the current SSH directory, caches installation packages, and forwards access over SSH to the Linux or Windows web editor.
